name: B10-0491/2025 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision renewing the authorisation for the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified maize MON 87427, pursuant to Regulation No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to renew the approval of a genetically modified maize, MON 87427. This maize can be used in food and feed but not grown in the EU. The Parliament worries about the weedkiller glyphosate, which the maize is bred to tolerate, and about gaps in long-term safety evidence. It also wants the EU to change how it decides on genetically modified organisms.

- Nothing changes yet: Parliament only asks the Commission to withdraw the plan.
- It affects the company Bayer, food and feed businesses, and shoppers.
- The Commission must now decide whether to drop or keep the plan.
